About the role

Reveleer is hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead product for both the HIE & AI Suspecting and Care Gap Manager domains within our Clinical Intelligence Suite of VBC solutions. The HIE and AI Suspecting product involves the retrieval of unstructured clinical data from health information exchanges (HIEs) and customers and applies AI suspecting to surface diagnosis and quality opportunities from that data. Care Gap informanager provides health plans and providers a common workbench to manage quality and risk care gaps, submit clinical evidence, and track incentive progress to align on and ensure the highest performance in their value-based arrangement.

The pods currently own separate links in one chain: retrieving clinical data, identifying opportunities, and closing gaps with provider evidence to support a highly effective and efficient VBC relationship. The Senior Product Manager sets the direction for how those links connect into one workflow for health plans and provider groups, then sequences work across both pods to build it.

The role combines product strategy, vendor management, regulatory tracking, and provider-facing workflow design. The person in this seat becomes the subject matter expert on HIEs within Clinical Intelligence: how they're structured, what regulations govern access and exchange, and what Reveleer's platform needs to build or change to keep pace. The same person holds the product depth on Care Gap Manager: how health plans configure quality and risk programs, how provider groups close gaps, and how incentive programs motivate that work.

What you'll own

Cross-pod vision and unification

Define and communicate a multi-year product vision that unifies the HIE & AI Suspecting pod and the Care Gap Manager pod, connecting data retrieval, AI suspecting, gap delivery, evidence submission, and gap closure into one workflow for health plans and provider groups.
Sequence investments across both pods into one prioritized roadmap, make trade-offs between pod-level and platform-level work explicit, and align both pods with the Reveleer Prospective workflows so risk and quality programs reuse data and workflows instead of duplicating them.

Product strategy and roadmap

Define and prioritize the roadmap for both pods based on customer and internal operations needs, data retrieval performance, AI suspecting accuracy, and Care Gap Manager adoption and gap closure outcomes.
Lead and participate in all agile ceremonies as the product representative for both pods, including daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, biweekly and monthly product management meetings, and retrospectives.
Partner with engineering and clinical teams to translate HIE, health plan, and provider group requirements into product requirements, maintaining accurate Product Requirements Documentation (PRDs) for all new feature development.
Set and track success metrics for retrieval coverage, data completeness, suspecting accuracy, gap closure rate, evidence validation turnaround, provider activation, and provider satisfaction (CSAT).
Own product documentation for both pods and work with other product leaders and Product Marketing (PMM) to train internal teams on HIE knowledge and product capabilities.

HIE vendor relationships

Own commercial and technical relationships with HIE vendors and network partners, including onboarding, contract renewals, and issue escalation.
Negotiate data access terms and service levels that support Reveleer's retrieval and coverage goals.
Serve as the primary point of contact between Reveleer and HIE partners for product and integration questions.
Set the multi-year HIE portfolio strategy, including which exchanges and networks to add, expand, or consolidate based on coverage and accuracy gains for both AI suspecting and gap delivery.

Regulatory and industry expertise

Track federal and state regulation affecting HIE data access, including information blocking rules, TEFCA, and state-level health information exchange requirements.
Inform internal stakeholders, including legal, compliance, engineering, and executive leadership, on what regulatory changes mean for Reveleer's broader data retrieval capabilities.
Maintain a working knowledge of the national and regional HIE landscape: which exchanges cover which geographies, how they differ in data format and access model, and where new exchanges or consolidations are changing the map.
Investigate any reported issues and prioritize engineering support as appropriate to reach resolution. Communicating resolutions back to customer support where appropriate.
Liaising with our compliance and legal teams to further shape our internal process and policy for triaging and reporting PHI-related issues as it relates to data received and reciprocated to HIEs and managing adherence to these policies.
Partner with Compliance and Legal to keep Care Gap Manager aligned with HIPAA and HITRUST requirements, including customer data segregation in a multi-tenant environment and audit-ready evidence logging.
